This '''planet''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and it was held by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] prior to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The Empire hired [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to hold the planet's system, which they did by taking control of several [[trineutronium]] power plants on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and threatening to detonate them&mdash;which would sterilize the planet and kill all 3.5 billion beings who lived there&mdash;if [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ships began landing, essentially taking the entire world hostage.
